description: This file contains SCSS styles for a Bootstrap-based responsive navigation bar (navbar). It defines styles for various parts of a navbar such as branding, navigation links, text, responsiveness, toggler button, and theme variations (light and dark). The styles include layout, positioning, and visual appearance, relying on Sass variables and mixins for customization.
external_files: Bootstrap mixins (@include font-size, hover-focus, border-radius, media-breakpoint-up, media-breakpoint-down, breakpoint-next, breakpoint-infix)
